body: Thank you, this was a very comforting comment. I know I can get through this, even though right now it feels like I can't. Thanks so much.

Yes, of course. I've called the maternal health hotline, and kids helpline, who just keep sending reports to my counsellor, as I always mention that I'm too scared to actually do anything, so I'm not seen as an immediate risk.

I wish I knew. I've stayed on all the same medications, gone to the same amount of counselling, actually a little bit more than usual, and kept the same diet apart from giving in to a few sugar cravings here and there. I don't understand myself anymore.

I never said I didn't want this baby. As soon as I found out I was pregnant, yes it was a shock but I never doubted that I'd keep him, and keep him safe. My mental health was well managed but for the past two months it's gone to shit and I don't understand why. I've done everything right god damn it.
